🚨 This season of *RHOA*, Marlo Hampton didn’t get her 🍑, and after interviews where she made it clear where she stands with some of the ladies, she also shared her feelings about Porsha. @porsha4real responds to Marlo’s claims that she’s a hater and stopped her bag! Check out the full interview on @netflix!

Donkey of the Day goes to a man who broke into a building and was caught in the bathroom because he had to poop 💩🚽 so badly that he told the police he was having a “bowel crisis”… sir, what did you eat 🫣???Tap into #DOTD, powered by @msllegal 🐂 #MichaelTheBull #TheBullNYC.

🚨 @repilhan breaks down why she extends grace to former Trump supporters who have changed their views on Trump’s policies. She gives grace to Taylor Greene but won’t be kicking it with her anytime soon. Check out the full conversation on @netflix

Video

Body cam footage has been released of King Harris’ arrest, and it shows T.I.P. arriving at the scene, hoping to bring him home. Tap into the latest w/ @lorenlorosa.

📰 Trump speaks out after an AI-generated image that many believed depicted him as Jesus, but insists he was supposed to be perceived as a doctor… and didn't apologize. Pope Leo has since criticized Trump and his administration since this was posted. Tap in as @mimibrowntv breaks down Front Page News!

Nikki Glaser spoke out about not caring if her husband had only a sexual connection outside of their marriage. Would you be okay with your partner having physical interaction with someone else with no emotional connection? 👀 Let's discuss ⬇️

Video
